verdict.rationale: Pipedream Connect explicitly supports per-end-user connected accounts via the x-pd-external-user-id header, with managed auth, encrypted credential storage, per-user revocation, and credentials never exposed to the model, directly matching the platform-engineer story. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs, and more detail on token scoping granularity per user across multiple apps.
